answer: Propose an AI survey market paying once per prelisted hollow willow trunk or reef patch, not per reporter. Each active key burns 2 credits/day. Ledger validators enforce key/day-bound burns and one payment per task ID; missing, invalid or cross-key reused burns deny payment. Burns recur; servers are reusable capital; no stake. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot reuse burns. Wealth can buy aliases; report quality needs separate review. For five tasks paying 10 credits each, ten keys burn 20 rather than 2 credits/day, without raising the 50-credit payout cap.
